The innovative fielding medal ceremony became a memorable dressing-room tradition during his tenure. Dilip cherished being part of numerous team triumphs across various formats.

description: A Noida teenager and her mother have moved homes three times after an FIR was filed. The FIR, based on a video, names the 15-year-old for alleged profanities. She has since apologized and is receiving threats on social media. Police personnel and strangers visited their residence, causing safety concerns for the family. The family has moved to an undisclosed location due to ongoing threats.

No decision has been made regarding Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's attendance at the BRICS Summit.

Tirkey expressed surprise at learning about the redesign through social media.  He emphasised the need for governance and consultation for symbolic decisions.  The president requested a comprehensive reply with documentary evidence by Tuesday.

title: Brij Bhushan acquitted in sexual harassment case
description: A Delhi court has acquitted former WFI chief Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh.  The sexual harassment case involved allegations from several women wrestlers.  Suspended WFI assistant secretary Vinod Tomar was also found not guilty.  The trial concluded after three years with the court examining many witnesses.  This verdict follows months of protests by prominent wrestlers demanding justice.

title: Shoulder surgery, 7 months out, one throw: How Yash Vir Singh won CWG bronze
description: Yash Vir Singh arrived in Glasgow with little attention but left with a Commonwealth Games bronze after a personal-best final throw. In this interview with TimesofIndia.com, he opens up about the injury that nearly derailed his career, the months spent in rehabilitation, Neeraj Chopra's words before his medal-winning attempt and the father who has guided him since his first throws with a bamboo javelin.

title: Jantar Mantar not okay for protests? SC seeks replies
description: The Supreme Court has asked the Centre and Delhi authorities for their responses.  A PIL seeks designated protest sites, citing Jantar Mantar's lack of amenities.  The court noted Jantar Mantar's unsuitability for holding protests and basic facilities.  Petitioner mentioned potential marches and police actions to prevent violence.  Authorities are responsible for handling emerging situations and ensuring law takes its course.

title: Lack of long-term plans to mitigate rain-inducted calamities worrying for Kerala
description: CM blames IMD for delay in relaying weather forecast. However, experts point out that IMD’s 125-year rainfall dataset, covering 110 weather stations across Kerala from 1901 to 2025, has shed enough light on the State’s most vulnerable regions during monsoon and the government need not wait for weather alerts before initiating preparedness measures

title: Vijay's Jana Nayagan crosses Rs 300 crore worldwide on Day 12
description: Jana Nayagan continues to perform well at the box office, earning over Rs 3.85 crore on its twelfth day. The film has achieved a total India gross collection of Rs 209.35 crore and Rs 179.45 crore net. Overseas collections have also been strong, contributing Rs 1 crore on day twelve. This brings the worldwide gross collection for Jana Nayagan to Rs 301.35 crore. The political action drama saw a 28.

Bankipur bypoll: PK adds a dash of yellow to Bihar palette of saffron & green
description: Prashant Kishor secured his first electoral victory in the Bankipur bypoll. This win challenges the established green and saffron political dominance in Bihar. Kishor, a renowned political strategist, launched his Jan Suraaj Party after extensive grassroots work. His victory sends a message to national parties regarding key issues. The outcome suggests Bihar may accommodate a third political force.

title: Lower min age for MD, directors to 18: Parliamentary panel
description: A parliamentary panel suggests lowering the minimum director age to eighteen years.  The committee also backs raising the maximum director age to seventy-five years.  Special NCLT benches for insolvency matters are recommended for efficient asset resolution.  The panel proposes retaining the ten crore net profit threshold for CSR applicability.  New provisions will enable seamless re-domiciliation of foreign companies to IFSC.

title: Foreign, private banks raise over 68% FCNR(B) funds
description: Foreign currency deposits saw a significant increase between June and July.  Banks aggressively mobilized these funds, taking advantage of RBI incentives.  HSBC, SBI, and ICICI Bank led the collection efforts for these deposits.  Foreign banks showed the fastest proportional growth in their deposit holdings.  Overall, the mobilization was concentrated among the top ten banking institutions.

title: Government to sell up to 6.5% stake in LIC, may mop up Rs 31k cr
description: The government is selling up to 6.5% of LIC shares through an offer for sale. This divestment aims to meet minimum public shareholding norms ahead of schedule. The offer begins Tuesday and closes Wednesday with a base price of Rs 382. Successful sale will raise approximately Rs 31,400 crore for the government. This move contributes significantly to the government's annual disinvestment target.

title: 21 Bangladesh nationals detained in J&K’s Ramban
description: Twenty-one Bangladesh nationals were detained in Ramban district last week.  Officials are questioning them to learn who facilitated their movement.  The group was caught moving in two vehicles during a checking drive.  None of them could produce valid identity or travel documents.  Investigators are probing if any network assisted these illegal immigrants.

title: J&K: Days after Kulgam terror attack, man with grenade held in Pulwama
description: A suspect was apprehended in Pulwama carrying a hand grenade and anti-national posters. This arrest occurred during a security operation following recent migrant worker killings. Authorities booked the local man under stringent anti-terror laws, including the UAPA. Security forces are increasing patrols and checkpoints across the valley. This intensified security aims to maintain peace and prevent further unlawful activities.

title: India crosses 20k organ transplants/yr for 1st time
description: India performed a record 20,138 organ transplants in 2025, a significant increase over previous years. Delhi-NCR led the nation in transplant procedures, while Tamil Nadu topped deceased organ donors. India now ranks third globally in total organ transplants, after the US and China. Deceased donor transplants continue to fall short of the substantial demand for organs. Government initiatives aim to strengthen organ donation and transplant services across the country.

title: Withdraw cases, allow youngsters to continue studies: SC to states
description: The Supreme Court permitted governments to withdraw cases against student protesters.  This move aims to allow students to pursue their studies without prosecution fears.  However, cases against individuals with criminal records will not be dropped.  The court will also establish guidelines for the use of graded force by police.  Discussions on modalities for dropping cases against genuine students are ongoing.

title: UFC fighter Allan Nascimento dies aged 34 after apparent heart attack
description: UFC flyweight Allan Nascimento has died at the age of 34, just weeks after his most recent fight. The promotion confirmed he suffered a medical emergency and shared details in an official statement. A Brazilian Jiu Jitsu black belt, Nascimento compiled a 22-7 professional record and earned respect for his submission skills. Tributes have poured in from fellow UFC stars, including Dustin Poirier, Henry Cejudo and Mackenzie Dern.

Parents' date and birthplace will also be recorded as declared by respondents. Passport and Aadhaar numbers may be collected voluntarily during the exercise. The questionnaire for this significant census phase will be notified soon.

No changes are currently being considered to replace the Unified Pension Scheme.

The victim, a mother of two, had previously warned the stalker about impending legal action.

description: LeBron James established a scholarship program for Akron students.  This initiative helps approximately eleven hundred students attend college.  The program stems from his own childhood struggles with financial instability.  He never attended college himself, entering the NBA directly after high school.  This mission provides a realistic chance for education beyond high school.

title: Nvidia CEO predicts these jobs will pay 6 figures as data centers boom
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang predicts a bright future for skilled tradespeople.  AI data center expansion drives significant infrastructure build-out globally.  This growth will create many six-figure jobs for electricians and construction workers.  Demand for electricians is particularly high for building AI facilities.  Other tech leaders also warn of labor shortages impacting manufacturing and construction.

title: A seat for JSP's 'school bag': Why Kishor's Bankipur win is a warning for BJP, RJD
description: Prashant Kishor achieved a remarkable victory in the Bankipur byelection, effectively breaking the BJP's three-decade dominance on the assembly seat. This triumph represents Kishor's resurgence in politics following his party's prior electoral drubbing in the state. He leveraged this win to critique Bihar's chief minister and emphasize the need for development. The outcome comes as an embarrassment for the current government's leadership.

title: Here's how Michael Phelps built his $100 million fortune in 2026
description: Michael Phelps turned his legendary Olympic achievements into a multi-million dollar empire. By securing high-value endorsements from renowned brands post-retirement, he also channeled his success into impactful ventures. His establishment of a foundation showcases his commitment to youth education in swimming and healthy living. Additionally, Phelps's investment in the mental health platform shows his suppport for emotional wellness.

Australian grandfather, 82, and grandson cycle 5,300km for MND
description: An 82-year-old grandfather and his 18-year-old grandson completed a nearly 5,300-kilometre cycling journey across Australia after riding for six weeks from Broome to Bowral. The pair undertook the challenge to raise money and awareness for motor neurone disease, inspired by a family member who died from the condition.

title: India-origin cricketer Reddy handed 8-year ban by ICC for corruption
description: USA cricketer Bodugum Akhilesh Reddy has been banned from all cricket for eight years after an ICC tribunal found him guilty of three Anti-Corruption Code breaches linked to the 2025 Abu Dhabi T10. He was found to have attempted match-fixing, encouraged a teammate to participate, and deleted evidence during the investigation. His ban is effective from November 21, 2025.

title: World Cup rights row: Wales withdraw support for Infantino's re-election bid
description: The Football Association of Wales (FAW) said it will no longer back Infantino's re-election campaign for the 2027-2031 term, following concerns over the failed investment plan.

title: Lauren Sanchez worked at waterpark; 40 years later, she takes luxurious ocean trips
description: Lauren Sanchez's career evolved from a teenage waterpark job to ocean conservation leadership. She recently explored the Galápagos Islands, highlighting shark importance. The Bezos Earth Fund supports significant marine conservation projects in the region. These initiatives protect vast ocean areas and numerous marine species. Sanchez's work now focuses on protecting vital ocean ecosystems.

title: Brittany Mahomes celebrates as Patrick Mahomes returns to Chiefs
description: Brittany Mahomes celebrated Patrick Mahomes' return to Chiefs training camp after his lengthy recovery from ACL and LCL injuries. She shared heartfelt moments from their family life, including sweet outings with their children. Patrick also marked his comeback and recent contract extension, expressing his love for Kansas City and gratitude for his family's unwavering support.

title: Africa plans $50bn Congo water diversion to revive shrinking Lake Chad
description: Lake Chad's dramatic shrinkage has brought about severe impacts on the lives of millions. To counteract this crisis, governments are investing in initiatives aimed at rehabilitating the lake's ecosystem. A noteworthy solution includes the ambitious Transaqua project, which seeks to channel water from the Congo River back into Lake Chad. This vital endeavor aims not only to replenish the lake but also to foster economic growth in the surrounding regions.
